notes: role -> vendor + model. Decentralization by heterogeneity: give different judge roles different model families so no single LLM dominates the promotion gate. 'vendor' in {anthropic, openai, gemini}; 'model' is that vendor's exact model id (edit to what your account has). API keys come from the environment: ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY / GEMINI_API_KEY. Each role's persona defaults to .claude/agents/<role>.md; override with 'persona' (inline) or 'persona_file'. 'params' is passed to the vendor (e.g. max_tokens, temperature). This file is human-owned policy — the runner never edits it. The openai/gemini model ids below are EXAMPLES; set them to real ids before a live run.
